capabilities: check Korean spelling and grammar in selected editor text
review detected issues in a popup or inline in the editor
apply, keep, ignore, or manually edit each correction
switch between the default proxy, NaraSpeller, and Bareun.ai providers
run optional AI review via OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or Ollama
extras: Manifest is marked BETA. The default grammar check routes selected text through the author's proxy at appstore.junlim.org; only selected text is sent, and no AI keys are needed unless AI review is enabled. Privacy section states there is no telemetry or remote account system.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Korean grammar or spelling checking, so writers must leave the vault to use external checkers.

summary: Korean spelling and grammar checker with popup and inline review, multiple grammar providers, and optional AI-assisted suggestions.
